name: Pixel Quest
description: Chunky pixel art drawn on a 180 by 320 grid and scaled up 4x: a side-scrolling level with a little hero, sky bands, pixel clouds, brick platforms and gems, under a retro HUD (hearts, XP bar, level number) with a dialog box for every tip.
best_use_cases: Tips and how-tos as game quests
List-style advice with a level-up payoff
style: Chunky 180x320 pixel art scaled up 4x with a retro HUD
